CREATE TABLE dbo.DimProduct
(
    ProductID INT,
    ProductName VARCHAR(100),
    Category VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    i.name AS IndexName,
    i.type_desc
FROM sys.tables t
INNER JOIN sys.indexes i
    ON t.object_id = i.object_id
WHERE t.name = 'dimproduct';
